Couture Standards

Why Sri Lankan Brides Choose Celoura

Pure Raw Silk & Micro-Velvet

We exclusively source premium grade raw silks, Italian velvets, and pure spun bullion zari threads for peerless drape and longevity.

Precision Custom Measurements

Every choli neckline, waist curve, and lehenga hem is cut specifically to your proportions, including seam allowances for easy future adjustments.

Transparent Workflow & Tracking

Watch your outfit progress through 6 structured statuses from order review to ready-for-fitting.

Direct Tailor Communication

Speak directly with our senior couturiers via WhatsApp or visit our Kirindiwela studio for fabric touch-and-feel.
